notes.title: Update 1.1.2: "No save file" fix
notes.content:
[b]Several of you reported that new update brought a critical bug: game was not saved on exit. Oof![/b]

Thanks to your reporting (especially 4RT1F1C1AL who provided an exact source of problem on discussion page), we could catch the Steam Cloud bug and fix it with this new update.

If you've already started the game and some of the progress was erased - sorry, and feel free to use one of these cheatcodes to get back to action a bit faster:
[spoiler]comphello[/spoiler] - to complete most of the first world
[spoiler]compunplug[/spoiler] - to complete most of the second world

Once again, sorry for all the troubles and thanks for reporting!

Ivan and Eva

notes.title: First update (and thank you all!)
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow detourists!
[/h1]

[b]First and foremost: thank you for all the support![/b]
Our game may not be the most popular one, but we hit a lot of cool milestones during the past two months, including:
[list]
[*]selling 1000 copies
[*]appearing in EDGE magazine and on Aliensrock channel
[*]getting to 100 reviews with 100% positive!
[/list]

[h3]We're so glad you are enjoying our game! As a small thank you, we made this "biggest small update".[/h3]
[b]What's inside?[/b]
[list]
[*]New hand-drawn comics for each world! If you've already completed the game, you can simply open first level of each world to see the funnies.
[*]Mac support
[*]Cloud sync support
[*]The ability to toggle speed up functionality instead of holding the button (advanced setting)
[*]Optimizations for game build - now it can run even on much older devices!
[*]Several bug and level fixes
[/list]

What does the future hold? More levels? Level editor? Ports to other platforms?
Time will tell, but we sure hope it's not our last "biggest small update" - and maybe one day we'll even deliver a "smallest big update".

[b]Again, thank you for supporting us, and see you around![/b]

notes.title: v.1.0.6: Third patch is a charm
notes.content:
Hello! Nothing too extreme here, mainly dealing with visual bugs.
Glad everyone is enjoying the game!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
- fixed visual bug on bonus levels in World 2, when robot friends didn't materialize when you collected all charge particles
- fixed visual bug in world 6 regarding undo + special blocks
- fixed mouse aim "sticking" when you grab battery on levels with moving blocks (this game really does have mouse controls hidden in the settings, try them!)
- removed unintended solutions on levels 56, 72, 85

We have a couple of QoL changes in mind (saveslots, cloud saves, etc.), will combine them with a small content update (really small!) and make an update in the near future. Feel free to suggest any QoL features in the comments you'd like to see!

notes.title: 1.0.5 update, a.k.a. second patch
notes.content:
[h1]Patchnotes[/h1]

- fixed unintended solution on lvl 85
- fixed double undo after death
- faster map load!
- fixed not respecting music volume setting on game load (also this hopefully fixes the inability to launch the game for some users)
- fixed visual bug on undo in bonus levels in world 2
- added antialiasing to some buttons
- fixed camera in the last level

[h3]More to come, stay tuned![/h3]
After things settle down we'll hopefully work on a small content update for Christmas/New Year :)

notes.title: v.1.0.4: First fixes!
notes.content:
[i]Hello, fellow detourists![/i]
Thank you so much for playing Robot Detour in the first days, streaming and reporting bugs! The release went almost smoothly... at least without any major bugs.

But still, there is always something to fix and to make better!
Here is our first patchnote:

[b]- fixed stunlock if you complete a level and touch enemy at the same time
- added missing strings for localizations (they were displayed in English before)
- navigating through map now always correctly moves the screen to desired page
- patched unintended solutions on levels 30, 69 and 84
- added third hint on level 21
- fixed battery behaviour on secret level in Arcade world
- fixed opening latter levels after using "skip Arcade world" button
- fixed rare bug when after breaking the game it starts operating in slow-mo[/b]

That's, of course, not all! We are still working on a couple of bugs and will fix them in the next update (specifically a bug where "undo" after death triggers twice for some people). Also expect some minor visual polish (with antialiasing) and being able to open pause menu on death screen.
We are also thinking through some of the suggestions and will address them in the nearest future (like cloud saves or an option to drive faster by default).

Thank you again for your enormous support during launch!
You are the best.

notes.title: Robot Detour is out!
notes.content:
Hello, players! Sorry we didn't communicate that much through Steam announcements, we were too busy finishing the game. When the studio is just two people, there is not much management you can do...

Anyways. Robot Detour is finally finished and out! Last year was a wild ride for the game and our studio, but we did our best to make this game shine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44724857/02637dc75ca6badd6329ea18d1c633e33ada8201.png[/img]

Just to name a few things about the final game:
- 88 levels in 6 worlds with completely new mechanics each time
- 3-4 hours for completing the game
- robust undo mechanic
- even more accessibility options in form of hints and ability to skip the dexterity part of the game
- hand-drawn opening comic
- the amount of polish we didn't even know this game could handle
- localisation to 12 languages
- perfect difficulty and unhinged fun mechanics

Hope you'll have a good time with our debut game. Looking forward to your reviews, and see you in Steam Discussions!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666840/Robot_Detour/

notes.title: Quality of life update #1
notes.content:
So, what do we have here...

[list]
[*] Finally: now you can undo several times! Even during the level!
[*] Keyboard navigation: now you can play with arrows or wasd without ever touching your mouse!
[*] Some other quality of life fixes that are still important, but not as important as first two points
[/list]

Have fun playing Robot Detour demo ~

notes.title: First demo fix (0.7.4)
notes.content:
- Fixed "undo" reverting to blocks stuck in the middle of animation
- Fixed broken pause/settings navigation
- Fixed unintended route in level 8
- Fixed SFX setting not affecting some sounds
- Fixed robot movement during pause menu

Hopefully that's all breaking changes! Next update will be about some smaller fixes, and then I'll work on "quality of life things" like infinite undo.
Till later!

notes.title: Robot Detour demo is out!
notes.content:
Hello Steam community! I am still not familiar with how "the stuff is done" here, but I know for sure that:

- we made a public demo for Robot Detour
- It has [almost] no game-breaking changes, the experience is pretty smooth
- I should initiate this contact with you 😌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44724857/c334c83884a0576df032bfb884ef345821a09aea.png[/img]

Our whole team is very glad to see all the reception, feedback and new people. We are glad you are enjoying the demo!

Expect several small fixes over the next days (we are just a couple of people working on the game in their free time), and I look forward to talking to you again soon. Till later!
